comment.text: MAP3K1 S1330 is represented as a recurrently mutated residue in Cancer Hotspots v2. Source observations include Bowel tumors; CNS tumors; Breast tumors; Cancer Hotspots source tumor code: cnsbrain; Cancer Hotspots source tumor code: esophagusstomach. Additional source tumor types are retained in the structured record. Statistical enrichment supports review as a candidate somatic hotspot; it does not establish the functional effect, pathogenicity, or treatment sensitivity of every alteration at this position.

Tumor counts describe source cohorts and may overlap between releases and sheets; they must not be added together.
An observed synonymous or stop allele is retained for source fidelity and is not automatically classified as oncogenic.
FDA references are separate gene-level evidence until the exact biomarker, tumor, setting, and current label have been checked.

report_comment.text: Somatic alterations affecting MAP3K1 residue S1330 have been observed in bowel tumors, breast tumors, and gastric tumors.
